Define research question and scope.description: Establish the fundamental research direction and boundaries. This foundational task sets the scope for all subsequent work and determines the project's focus and feasibility.

Summarize key related work and baselines.description: Conduct a literature review and synthesize existing approaches. This task provides context and establishes baselines for comparison, informing the experimental design.

Design experiment plan and evaluation pr.description: Create a comprehensive experimental design including evaluation metrics, data splits, and statistical analysis plans. This task ensures rigorous and reproducible experimental methodology.

Implement baseline method.description: Develop and code the baseline approaches for comparison. This implementation provides the foundation for evaluating improvements and understanding the problem space.

Implement proposed method or key compone.description: Develop the core novel contribution of the research project. This task represents the primary technical innovation and is critical for demonstrating the research's value.

Build data preprocessing / loader pipeli.description: Create robust data handling infrastructure including preprocessing, augmentation, and efficient loading mechanisms. This enables all experimental work and ensures data quality.

Run sanity checks and debugging experime.description: Execute preliminary tests to verify implementations work correctly and identify bugs. These checks prevent wasted computational resources and ensure experimental validity.

Run main experiments.description: Execute the primary experimental evaluation that tests the core research hypotheses. These experiments generate the key results that support the paper's main claims.

Run ablation studies.description: Conduct systematic experiments to understand the contribution of different components. Ablation studies provide insights into what makes the method effective and strengthen the analysis.

Analyze results and produce plots/tables.description: Process experimental outcomes, create visualizations, and compile results into interpretable formats. This analysis transforms raw data into actionable insights and publication-ready figures.

Draft core paper sections (method/experi.description: Write the technical content describing the methodology and experimental setup. These sections form the backbone of the paper and communicate the research contribution clearly.

Revise writing and tighten argumentation.description: Refine the paper's narrative flow, strengthen logical connections, and improve clarity. This revision process elevates the writing quality and ensures the argument is compelling.

Package code and write a reproducibility.description: Organize codebase, create documentation, and prepare materials for reproducibility. This task enables others to build upon the work and demonstrates research integrity.

Prepare slides for an internal presentat.description: Create presentation materials summarizing the research progress and key findings. This communication task helps gather feedback and share insights with collaborators.
